items.name: GOOGLE HANGOUTS
items.image_alt: Monochrome museum engraving of a laptop, phone, and webcam in a group video call
items.epitaph: The chat window that gathered messages and video calls was redirected into another room.
items.why: Google migrated remaining users and most conversations to Google Chat as it consolidated communication products.
items.afterlife: Archived conversations, screenshots, and Google Takeout exports preserve its decade of chats and calls.
items.note: Google introduced the cross-platform Hangouts service in 2013 and made it unavailable in November 2022.
